subject.title: fix(reef): bound JSONL store file reads to prevent OOM on oversized audit/replay stores

question: For existing Reef replay ledgers already over the new 32 MiB limit, should the supported recovery contract be fail closed with operator-managed rotation/compaction, or should Reef provide a separately designed safe repair flow?
rationale: A bounded-prefix rewrite cannot safely retain receipt records beyond the cap, while unbounded loading risks gateway OOM; selecting the operational recovery contract is a security and product policy choice.

options.title: Confirm fail-closed recovery
options.body: Keep the proposed clear error and require operators to compact or rotate the full replay ledger outside the bounded reader.

options.title: Design a verified repair flow
options.body: Pause this PR until Reef has an owner-approved recovery mechanism that preserves all replay receipts without reading an unbounded file.

recommendation.title: Confirm fail-closed recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed clear error and require operators to compact or rotate the full replay ledger outside the bounded reader.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has the most directly evidenced history on the proposed Reef store contract, though a repository owner should make the final policy decision.
